slides.title: Sab ek [[saath]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name,
  SUM(o.amount) AS spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 400
ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5;
slides.note: JOIN + GROUP BY + HAVING + ORDER BY + LIMIT: **full combo** 🎮
